root_cause: PR #2100 deliberately ended at a trusted normalized event boundary. The concrete Host composition has no provider-specific listener responsible for GitHub HMAC verification, workflow_run normalization, exact raw-payload evidence, and delivery replay ownership before calling that boundary.
causal_chain: EventDrivenCIProviderAdapter publishes an exact github.actions wait and leaves external delivery to the integration layer.
DurableExternalEventScheduler requires trusted normalized evidence and intentionally rejects ownership of Provider authentication.
The bootstrap and initializer configure only GitHub API access plus the generic Scheduler, so no live component owns webhook receipt.
Consequently a real GitHub webhook cannot cross into the existing exact Scheduler/Host resume path without an unsafe hand-written normalization step.
rejected_hypotheses: The generic Scheduler should verify GitHub signatures; rejected because that would mix Provider authentication with provider-neutral wait delivery.
The CI Provider adapter should run an HTTP server; rejected because the adapter owns result interpretation inside Workflow execution, not Host transport or ingress lifecycle.
Polling GitHub is an equivalent repair; rejected because the accepted architecture is event-driven and forbids provider polling or sleep loops.
